name: gramatr
description: grāmatr — real-time intelligent context engineering for Claude Desktop. Every prompt pre-classified via multi-head classification pipeline; behavioral directives and quality criteria delivered before the model responds.
long_description:
grāmatr℠ is a patent-pending real-time intelligent context engineering layer. This extension bundles a local stdio bridge that connects Claude Desktop to the grāmatr intelligence server at api.gramatr.com.

Every prompt runs through a multi-head classification pipeline (~5 ms) that pre-routes the request, assembles behavioral directives and quality criteria, and pulls relevant context from past work — so the model skips orientation overhead and starts working immediately.

Four measurable wins:
• ~2,700 tokens delivered as input context per request, displacing the reasoning Claude would otherwise generate as expensive output tokens
• System-prompt collapse — structured contract replaces tens of thousands of tokens of behavioral enforcement
• Semantic retrieval — past decisions, preferences, and project state pulled in automatically
• Consistent behavior — the same directives and quality gates on every prompt, every session; each output gated with a recorded PASS/FAIL

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 — the bundled bridge discovers the auth server (RFC 9728 / RFC 8414), registers a public PKCE client dynamically, and runs the authorization-code flow (RFC 8628 device-code for headless). No API key, no manual client setup.
